title: Team Sports
subtitle: 「團隊運動／團體運動／隊際比賽」，究竟是哪一種 team sports？
description: 「團隊運動／團體運動／隊際比賽」，究竟是哪一種 team sports？

words.note: 最直接的描述性替換之一，表示需要多人共同參與的運動；但有些 group sports 不一定有固定隊伍，因此範圍可比 team sports 稍廣。
words.example: The school encourages students to take part in group sports after class.
words.exampleZh: 學校鼓勵學生課後參與團體運動。

exercises.original: The school offers several team sports after class.
exercises.zh: 學校課後提供多種團體運動。
exercises.upgrade: group sports · 團體運動；群體運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 和 team sports 的合作形式相反。
team building = 不是正式運動類型。
group sports = 在學校活動中泛指多人共同參與的運動時，group sports 可自然概括。
sports clubs = 是組織，不是運動本身。
athletics only = 會把範圍錯誤收窄到田徑。
group exercise = 可能沒有分隊或比賽。

exercises.original: Children learn social skills through team sports.
exercises.zh: 兒童透過團體運動學習社交技巧。
exercises.upgrade: group sports · 團體運動；群體運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 不如 group sports 強調同伴互動。
solo training = 相反。
sports clubs = club 是組織。
group sports = 如果重點是多人互動而非嚴格比賽分類，group sports 可用。
team building = 不是運動分類。
exercise classes = 不一定涉及隊伍合作。

exercises.original: The centre encourages older adults to join suitable team sports.
exercises.zh: 中心鼓勵長者參與合適的團體運動。
exercises.upgrade: group sports · 團體運動；群體運動

options.explanation: athletics = 未必是團隊型。
individual sports = 相反。
sports clubs = 不能直接 join sports clubs 來替代運動類型。
team building = 不合。
group sports = 這裡重點是多人共同運動，group sports 是可接受的廣義替換。
solo exercise = 相反。

words.note: 較正式、描述性，強調運動是以團隊合作、分工和共同目標為核心；常見於教育、研究和體育政策語境。
words.example: Team-based athletics can help students develop communication skills.
words.exampleZh: 團隊型體育活動可以幫助學生培養溝通能力。

exercises.original: The programme uses team sports to develop leadership and cooperation.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃利用團隊型體育活動培養領導和合作能力。
exercises.upgrade: team-based athletics · 團隊型體育活動

options.explanation: individual athletics = 不能突出 cooperation。
group exercise = 未必有隊伍角色。
team building = 不是正式體育活動類型。
team-based athletics = 教育或研究語體中，強調團隊合作的體育活動可描述為 team-based athletics。
sports clubs = 不是活動本身。
solo competition = 相反。

exercises.original: Participation in team sports is associated with stronger peer interaction.
exercises.zh: 參與團隊型體育活動與較強的同儕互動有關。
exercises.upgrade: team-based athletics · 團隊型體育活動

options.explanation: athletics = 太廣，很多 athletics 是個人項目。
individual sports = 不合 peer interaction 重點。
fitness classes = 不一定分隊。
team building = 不屬正式 sports participation。
team-based athletics = 正式研究語境中可用 team-based athletics 突出 sports 的團隊結構。
sports clubs = 是機構參與，不是運動形式。

exercises.original: The school balances individual events with team sports.
exercises.zh: 學校在個人項目和團隊型體育活動之間取得平衡。
exercises.upgrade: team-based athletics · 團隊型體育活動

options.explanation: athletics generally = 會失去 individual vs team 的對比。
group exercise = 未必是競技運動。
sports clubs = 不是 events。
solo sports = 和前半句重複。
team meetings = 不合。
team-based athletics = individual events 與 team-based 形成清楚對比。

words.note: 常見而自然，尤其指 football、basketball、hockey 等以隊伍對抗形式進行的運動；比 team sports 稍偏比賽／遊戲性。
words.example: The programme includes several team games such as football and basketball.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃包括足球和籃球等多種團隊比賽。

exercises.original: Football and basketball are popular team sports at the school.
exercises.zh: 足球和籃球是學校很受歡迎的團隊比賽。
exercises.upgrade: team games · 團隊球類／團隊比賽

options.explanation: individual events = 足球和籃球不是個人項目。
group exercise = 這兩項有固定隊伍和比賽規則。
athletics events = 通常不這樣分類。
team building activities = 不是正式比賽運動。
team games = football / basketball 這類以兩隊對抗的運動很自然稱 team games。
sports clubs = 不是運動名稱。

exercises.original: The PE lesson included two team sports and one individual activity.
exercises.zh: 體育課包括兩項團隊比賽和一項個人活動。
exercises.upgrade: team games · 團隊球類／團隊比賽

options.explanation: sports clubs = 課堂不是加入組織。
group exercise = 可能沒有比賽性。
athletics = 太廣。
team meetings = 不是體育。
individual sports = 與原意相反。
team games = PE 課中的具體比賽型運動可自然叫 team games。

exercises.original: Students chose between several team sports during games afternoon.
exercises.zh: 學生在運動下午活動中從多項團隊比賽中選擇。
exercises.upgrade: team games · 團隊球類／團隊比賽

options.explanation: team games = games afternoon + 多種隊際運動非常適合 team games。
group exercise classes = 未必是 game format。
sports clubs = 不是一次活動內容。
athletics only = 太窄。
solo events = 相反。
team building = 不是正式 sport choice。

words.note: 和 team sports 非常接近，強調參加者以固定或明確隊伍合作完成比賽。
words.example: The club offers a range of team-based sports for teenagers.
words.exampleZh: 會所為青少年提供多種團隊型運動。

exercises.original: The club offers team sports for children aged eight to twelve.
exercises.zh: 會所為八至十二歲兒童提供團隊型運動。
exercises.upgrade: team-based sports · 團隊型運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 形式相反。
group exercise = 不一定有隊伍。
team building = 不是運動分類。
sports clubs = 句法和語義不合。
athletics only = 太窄。
team-based sports = team-based sports 幾乎是 team sports 的直接正式改寫。

exercises.original: Research suggests team sports can support social development.
exercises.zh: 研究顯示團隊型運動有助社交發展。
exercises.upgrade: team-based sports · 團隊型運動

options.explanation: team-based sports = 研究語境中，team-based sports 是清楚、正式的替換。
individual athletics = 不突出合作。
fitness training = 未必有 team interaction。
team meetings = 不合。
sports organizations = 不是運動本身。
group exercise only = 範圍不同。

exercises.original: The facility has courts and pitches for team sports.
exercises.zh: 設施設有供團隊型運動使用的球場和場地。
exercises.upgrade: team-based sports · 團隊型運動

options.explanation: individual sports only = courts/pitches 可供多人隊際運動。
team-based sports = courts and pitches 與 team-based sports 的場地需求直接對應。
sports clubs = 場地不是為組織本身而設。
group exercise = 不一定需要 pitches。
team building = 不是體育設施主要分類。
solo athletics = 不合。

words.note: 較正式、較少見，表示參加者作為一個整體共同完成競賽或活動；在學術或國際英語中較可能見到。
words.example: Collective sports often require coordination between players.
words.exampleZh: 集體運動往往要求隊員之間互相協調。

exercises.original: The study compares individual and team sports.
exercises.zh: 這項研究比較個人運動和集體運動。
exercises.upgrade: collective sports · 集體運動；團體運動

options.explanation: collective sports = 正式分類中，和 individual sports 對比時，collective sports 可作較學術替換。
group exercise = 未必是 sport competition。
sports clubs = 不是可與 individual sports 並列的類別。
athletics = 範圍和分類不對。
team building = 不合。
fitness classes = 不合。

exercises.original: Collective sports require players to coordinate their actions.
exercises.zh: 集體運動要求隊員協調彼此行動。
exercises.upgrade: collective sports · 集體運動；團體運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 不依賴隊員間協調。
collective sports = players coordinate their actions 直接支持 collective-sport 概念。
group exercise = 未必有 roles/actions coordination。
sports clubs = 不是運動形式。
solo events = 相反。
team meetings = 不合。

exercises.original: The curriculum includes both individual disciplines and team sports.
exercises.zh: 課程同時包括個人項目和集體運動。
exercises.upgrade: collective sports · 集體運動；團體運動

options.explanation: group fitness = 不一定是 sport。
sports organizations = 不合 curriculum items。
collective sports = 學術／課程分類中可用 collective sports 和 individual disciplines 對比。
athletics only = 太窄。
solo training = 與 collective 相反。
team building exercises = 不等於運動項目。

words.note: 當 team sports 的重點是合作、協調和共同完成任務時可用；比一般 team sports 更突出 cooperation。
words.example: Cooperative sports can strengthen trust among participants.
words.exampleZh: 合作型運動可以增強參加者之間的信任。

exercises.original: The programme uses team sports to teach cooperation.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃利用合作型運動教授合作能力。
exercises.upgrade: cooperative sports · 合作型運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 不能突出 team cooperation。
cooperative sports = 當重點直接是 cooperation，cooperative sports 比一般 team sports 更貼切。
competitive solo events = 和合作重點相反。
sports clubs = 不是運動本身。
group exercise = 未必有協作目標。
team meetings = 不合。

exercises.original: Younger children benefit from team sports that require sharing and coordination.
exercises.zh: 年幼兒童能從需要分享和協調的合作型運動中受益。
exercises.upgrade: cooperative sports · 合作型運動

options.explanation: individual athletics = 不需分享隊內角色。
group fitness = 不一定合作完成目標。
cooperative sports = sharing and coordination 是 cooperative sports 的直接線索。
team building = 可培養合作，但不一定是 sport。
sports clubs = 不合。
solo games = 相反。

exercises.original: The camp includes non-contact team sports focused on working together.
exercises.zh: 訓練營包括著重共同合作的非接觸式合作型運動。
exercises.upgrade: cooperative sports · 合作型運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 與 working together 相反。
fitness classes = 未必以隊伍合作。
athletics = 太廣。
cooperative sports = focused on working together 明確突出 cooperative 性質。
sports clubs = 不是活動。
solo competition = 相反。

words.note: 當 team sports 明確涉及兩隊或多隊互相競爭、計分和勝負時適用；比 general team sports 更突出競技性。
words.example: Students take part in competitive team games during the tournament.
words.exampleZh: 學生在比賽期間參與競技團隊比賽。

exercises.original: The tournament features several team sports between local schools.
exercises.zh: 比賽設有多項本地學校之間的競技團隊比賽。
exercises.upgrade: competitive team games · 競技團隊比賽

options.explanation: group exercise = 沒有競賽勝負。
team building = 不是 tournament sport。
competitive team games = tournament + schools competing 明確支持 competitive team games。
individual events = 和 team 格式相反。
sports clubs = 不是賽事項目。
recreational activity = 會弱化 tournament 競技性。

exercises.original: Students train twice a week for team sports in the inter-school league.
exercises.zh: 學生每週訓練兩次，為校際聯賽的競技團隊比賽作準備。
exercises.upgrade: competitive team games · 競技團隊比賽

options.explanation: fitness classes = 不是 league competition。
individual athletics = 不合 team league。
team building sessions = 不是賽事。
competitive team games = inter-school league 表示正式隊際競賽。
sports clubs = 不是 games 本身。
group exercise = 缺少競技性。

exercises.original: The festival includes friendly and competitive team sports.
exercises.zh: 節慶同時包括友誼性和競技團隊比賽。
exercises.upgrade: competitive team games · 競技團隊比賽

options.explanation: individual sports = 不合。
group exercise = 無法表達 friendly vs competitive games。
athletics = 太廣。
sports clubs = 不合。
competitive team games = 描述比賽形式和競技程度時，team games 比 general sports 更自然。
team meetings = 不合。

words.note: 當重點是由學校、會所、聯賽或機構正式安排、有固定規則和隊伍時可用。
words.example: Participation in organized team sports is high among local teenagers.
words.exampleZh: 本地青少年參與有組織團隊運動的比例很高。

exercises.original: Many teenagers participate in team sports through schools and clubs.
exercises.zh: 很多青少年透過學校和會所參與有組織的團隊運動。
exercises.upgrade: organized team sports · 有組織的團隊運動

options.explanation: informal play = 和 schools/clubs 的正式安排不同。
individual sports = 不合。
group exercise = 未必有固定隊伍與規則。
organized team sports = through schools and clubs 明確表示有組織的團隊運動。
team building = 不合。
sports clubs = 是組織本身。

exercises.original: The survey asked how often children take part in team sports with regular coaching.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問兒童多久參與一次有定期教練指導的團隊運動。
exercises.upgrade: organized team sports · 有組織的團隊運動

options.explanation: casual games = 和 regular coaching 不符。
individual exercise = 不合。
group fitness = 未必有固定 team。
sports clubs = 不是 participation activity 本身。
organized team sports = regular coaching 是 organized sport 的直接線索。
team building = 不合。

exercises.original: Access to team sports often depends on local leagues and facilities.
exercises.zh: 參與有組織的團隊運動往往取決於本地聯賽和設施。
exercises.upgrade: organized team sports · 有組織的團隊運動

options.explanation: solo exercise = 不依賴 leagues。
group exercise = 不一定需要 league structure。
team meetings = 不合。
sports clubs only = club 只是提供者。
individual events = 不合。
organized team sports = local leagues and facilities 清楚指向 organized team sports。

words.note: 較概括、稍正式，表示以隊伍形式進行的體育活動；自然度略低於 team sports / team-based sports，但在教育和體育分類中可用。
words.example: The camp combines individual events with team athletics.
words.exampleZh: 訓練營把個人項目和團隊體育活動結合起來。

exercises.original: The camp combines individual sports with team sports.
exercises.zh: 訓練營把個人運動和團隊體育活動結合起來。
exercises.upgrade: team athletics · 團隊體育活動

options.explanation: group exercise = 未必是競技體育。
team building = 不合 sports curriculum。
sports clubs = 不是活動類型。
individual athletics = 和前半句重複。
team athletics = 在較正式分類中，team athletics 可和 individual sports 對比。
fitness classes = 範圍不同。

exercises.original: The school gives equal time to individual events and team sports.
exercises.zh: 學校給予個人項目和團隊體育活動同等時間。
exercises.upgrade: team athletics · 團隊體育活動

options.explanation: sports clubs = 不是 curriculum time allocation 的運動類型。
group fitness = 不一定 team-based。
team building = 不屬正式 sports events。
solo sports = 和 individual events 重複。
free play = 不是同等正式運動分類。
team athletics = 教育課程中把 individual events 與 team athletics 並列，可作正式表達。

exercises.original: Students can choose from several forms of team sports.
exercises.zh: 學生可以從多種團隊體育活動中選擇。
exercises.upgrade: team athletics · 團隊體育活動

options.explanation: team athletics = 作為較廣義體育分類，team athletics 可用，但自然度低於 team sports。
individual sports = 不合。
sports clubs = 不合。
group exercise classes = 未必屬 athletics。
team meetings = 不合。
solo events = 相反。

words.note: 當 team sports 的重點只是需要多名參加者共同參與時可接近；但 multiplayer 不一定代表固定隊伍，因此需有明確上下文。
words.example: The centre offers multiplayer sports in its indoor hall.
words.exampleZh: 中心在室內場館提供多種多人運動。

exercises.original: The centre offers team sports that require several participants at once.
exercises.zh: 中心提供需要多名參加者同時參與的多人運動。
exercises.upgrade: multiplayer sports · 多人運動

options.explanation: individual sports = 相反。
solo exercise = 相反。
sports clubs = 不是運動本身。
team building = 未必是正式 sport。
athletics only = 太窄。
multiplayer sports = 若重點只是多名參加者同場，multiplayer sports 可作描述性替換。

exercises.original: Some indoor team sports are designed for small groups.
exercises.zh: 一些室內多人運動是為小組參與而設。
exercises.upgrade: multiplayer sports · 多人運動

options.explanation: multiplayer sports = small groups + multiple participants 使 multiplayer sports 合理。
solo sports = 和 small groups 相反。
individual athletics = 不合。
sports organizations = 不是活動。
team meetings = 不合。
exercise alone = 相反。

exercises.original: The games hall is used for team sports involving four or more players.
exercises.zh: 遊戲館用於四人或以上參與的多人運動。
exercises.upgrade: multiplayer sports · 多人運動

options.explanation: individual events = 不合。
multiplayer sports = four or more players 明確強調 multiplayer，而不一定強調固定隊伍。
solo training = 相反。
sports clubs = 不合。
team building sessions = 不一定是 sport。
athletics tracks = 不合室內 games hall。

words.note: 當 team sports 的重點是以隊伍身份參加正式競賽時可用；更偏賽事形式，而不是運動類型本身。
words.example: The festival includes several team competitions for local schools.
words.exampleZh: 這個節慶包括多項供本地學校參與的隊際比賽。

exercises.original: The school festival includes several team sports between year groups.
exercises.zh: 學校節慶包括多項年級之間的隊際比賽。
exercises.upgrade: team competitions · 團隊競賽；隊際比賽

options.explanation: team competitions = 如果重點是不同隊伍彼此競賽，team competitions 最精確。
group exercise = 不是隊際勝負。
individual events = 不合。
sports clubs = 不是 competition。
team building = 不合。
fitness sessions = 不是賽事。

exercises.original: The event finishes with team sports between the departments.
exercises.zh: 活動最後以部門之間的隊際比賽作結。
exercises.upgrade: team competitions · 團隊競賽；隊際比賽

options.explanation: individual sports = 沒有部門 team 對抗。
team competitions = between the departments 表示正式隊際對抗。
group exercise = 不強調勝負。
sports clubs = 不合。
team meetings = 不合。
training sessions = 不是活動結尾的正式競賽。

exercises.original: Employees can enter individual events or team sports.
exercises.zh: 員工可以參加個人項目或隊際比賽。
exercises.upgrade: team competitions · 團隊競賽；隊際比賽

options.explanation: group exercise = 不能和 individual events 形成競賽類別對比。
sports clubs = 不合 enter。
team competitions = enter + individual events / team categories 表示比賽報名，因此 team competitions 很自然。
team building activities = 不一定是 competition。
fitness classes = 不合。
solo training = 與 individual events 重複。

falseSynonyms.zh: 個人運動與團隊運動相反 individual sports 主要由個人獨立參賽，例如 singles tennis、gymnastics；team sports 依賴隊員合作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Individual sports focus on one competitor; team sports depend on coordinated group play.

falseSynonyms.zh: 集體運動課不等於團隊競技 group exercise 可以是一班人一起做瑜伽、健身或有氧運動，但未必分隊、競賽或合作完成目標。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People can exercise in a group without playing a team sport.

falseSynonyms.zh: 團隊建立活動不等於團隊運動 team building 是提升合作與關係的活動，可能包括遊戲，但不一定是正式運動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Team building may use games, but it is not the same as team sports.

falseSynonyms.zh: athletics 不一定表示團隊運動 athletics 在英式英語常指田徑，很多項目是個人比賽；不能一般地等同 team sports。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Many athletics events are individual rather than team-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: team games 只在部分語境等同 team sports team games 很接近，但更偏『比賽／遊戲』，而 team sports 可包括更正式的訓練與運動分類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Team games are a major type of team sport, but the terms are not always identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 多人不一定代表分隊 multiplayer 只表示多人參加；多人活動可以人人獨立競爭，不一定是 team-based。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A multiplayer event can involve many individuals without fixed teams.

falseSynonyms.zh: 體育會不等於運動類型 sports club 是提供訓練或組織活動的機構；team sports 是運動形式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A sports club may offer many team sports.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單數與複數不同 team sport 指一種團隊運動；team sports 指多種或整體類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Football is a team sport. Football and basketball are team sports.
